about.description: Perpetual market on trade[XYZ] tracking the iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ), which provides exposure to a market-cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap Brazilian equities. Positions are linear, margined and cash-settled in USDC on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
